policy: Reviewed anonymous employer recruiting routes that need a more specific list entry than the generic registry seed. No login, applicant, resume-upload or private endpoints are allowed. Optional detail_url_template values must be observed public job-detail routes and may interpolate only the public position {id}.

sources.evidence: Current Kuaishou Campus public recruiting SPA; anonymous browser observation confirmed the public detail route #/campus/job-info/{id} and /api/v1/open/positions/find?id={id}.

Current Kuaishou public recruiting SPA social route; the public job-info route is keyed by the position id exposed by the anonymous positions/simple API and is regression-checked in the recruitment-domain workflow.
JD's current employer-owned recruiting home renders live job rows and links to social/campus/intern recruiting sections.
